Best 2,000Wh solar generator kits with panels (2026)

For a solar generator kit around 2,000Wh (2kWh), I'd prioritize LiFePO4 batteries, at least 2,000W AC output, 400W or more of solar panels, and a strong warranty.

A 2,000Wh battery can typically power a refrigerator, laptops, lights, a router, and other essentials during an outage. With solar panels, you can recharge it during daylight.

One important distinction: 2,000Wh is battery capacity, while 2,000W is power output. For a complete kit, you'll want to compare both.

My recommendation

ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 + 400W is the strongest price-to-capacity option I found. If you want a full 2,000Wh-plus battery and a more powerful inverter, I'd favor the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 400W.

One caveat: a 400W panel setup may need roughly 6–9 effective peak-sun hours to replenish a 2kWh battery, depending on losses and weather. For regular off-grid use, I'd consider 600–800W of solar.
